text:
jen: NimbusCare wants to convert the POC to a paid order. They returned MSA+DPA redlines and asked for Net60. Need quick alignment on payment terms, POC SLA wording, and who can sign the order form. cc @meera @theo

theo: Quick read  they struck our audit clause and added a customer HSM requirement. For a 2-week evaluation we should decline HSM and offer KMS attestation. Also suggest a short POC addendum that scopes data and retention.

meera: Legal: I can draft a one-page POC addendum today. It'll: 1) limit audit to a scoped attestation, 2) specify data deletion 30 days post-POC, 3) mark HSM as "production only".

paul: Finance: Net60 is OK only after credit sign-off. For POCs we typically need prepay or an approved PO. I can approve Net45 + 50% prepay for this account pending billing contact and W-9.

jen: SE context: POC runs on dedicated capacity for ~2 weeks; load tests may spike. We shouldn't promise prod SLAs. Recommend wording: "POC performance objective (non-binding): median latency target 150ms" and include a perf annex. @theo can you validate numbers?

theo: SE  I'll run a perf test Monday. If median <150ms we'll use that as the objective. Agree to non-binding language.

legal-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood-secure/qs/4512 They flagged HSM. For POC we provide KMS attestation only; update DPA language accordingly.

meera: On signatures: we accept e-sign from an authorized procurement rep with PO attachment. I'll add to the order form: "Order Form must be signed by an authorized Buyer representative and include Buyer PO# if issued."

paul: Confirming: Sales OK with Net45 + 50% prepay? Customer may push for milestones but that complicates invoicing. Also need remit address and tax id on PO.

jen: Proposal to NimbusCare: 1) 1-page POC addendum limiting audit + 30d data deletion; 2) Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45; 3) SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding) median 150ms; 4) E-sign allowed with PO attached. Any objections?

meera: No objections. I'll circulate the addendum for quick sign-off and remove mandatory HSM for the POC.

theo: I'll attach perf logs after the Monday run.

paul: I'll start credit hygiene and ask them to send PO/W-9 to billing@redwood.example. If they insist on Net60, escalate for a credit exception.

jen: Action recap: @meera draft addendum + update DPA; @theo perf run Monday; @paul collect PO + W-9; I'll prepare e-sign envelope and route when addendum is ready. :thumbsup:

jen: Small order form snippet I'll send:
```
Term: POC (2 weeks)
Payment: 50% prepay, remainder Net45 from invoice date
SLA: POC performance objective (non-binding)  median latency target 150ms
Data: Data deletion within 30 days after POC
```

jen: If no objections to prepay or non-binding SLA I'll push this to the customer and request PO + billing details.
